notes: Best 10-vertex configuration found is the bicapped square antiprism with V* = (48 + 16 sqrt2 + (48 sqrt2 - 32) sqrt(5 + 3 sqrt2))/81 = 2.2187111315. Hoehner-Ledford's trivalent-vertex bound (their Lemma 3.10, all N) is below a certified volume for every N in 10..21 except 12, so maximisers for these N have no degree-3 vertex; for N = 10 this leaves the 12 triangulations with minimum degree 4 (plantri). Outside Lean: all of it (cited lemmas, mpmath interval evaluation of max F_N, exact rational volume lower bounds, plantri count).
